story-context.title: AU-Only Diagnostic Evaluation Framework + Baseline
story-context.overview: Build the AU-only diagnostic evaluation framework and produce the first current-state AU baseline. This story creates framework capability, diagnostic artifacts, judge package extensions, deterministic AU checks, and baseline evidence. It must not apply prompt improvements.

critical-objectives.item: Create an AU launch benchmark prompt set with stable row IDs and explicit adversarial tags for intentional source-market adaptation rows.
Create a version-managed AU locale contract and deterministic AU failure checks.
Package the complete LLM prompt context by stable shared sections with content hashes.
Extend judge prompts/templates/ingest with conflict diagnostics and likely responsible prompt/context section fields.
Run and record the current-state AU baseline, including judge ingest and AU-000 tracking-sheet update.
Do not test candidate prompt/context improvements in this story.

dependencies.story: Merged; H3 closed measured/no-change and prompt code was not shipped.
Complete; prior rubric_v2 baseline evidence exists but is noisy because it spans six locales.
Complete; locale registry and brand posture wiring exist.
Complete; judge package and ingest tooling exists.
dependencies.doc: Persistent Analyst process document that Story 6.4.7 will use.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic; no migration is expected.
Do NOT apply prompt improvements or candidate prompt blocks.
Do NOT continue the previous six-locale prompt-candidate sweep.
Do NOT modify frontend unless implementation proves it is required.
Do NOT add a production API surface for eval-only diagnostics.
Use PowerShell-safe commands; no ampersand chaining.
Tony must run/save manual Cursor judge outputs if model sessions are required.

path.note: Existing prompts-v1.1 reference; audit/reuse/rewrite into the new AU-only prompt set.
Support AU prompt set loading, context preflight, deterministic AU checks, and baseline artifact output.
Package shared context bundle, per-case section refs, deterministic findings, and diagnostic judge instructions.
Validate and summarize new diagnostic judge fields.
Use existing prompt assembly helpers as the source of truth for complete context; avoid production API expansion unless unavoidable.
Update/add tests for AU prompt set and run artifacts.
Update/add tests for shared context bundle and diagnostic judge package shape.
Update/add tests for diagnostic judge field validation and summaries.
